A1.justification: Local reading tools stalled without returning document content. Neither PDF nor its appendices could be inspected, so the work's identity and material completeness could not be verified. This is an access failure, not evidence of missing content.

before.justification: v2.pdf could not be inspected to determine whether it reports original empirical results.

after.justification: v3.pdf could not be inspected to determine whether it reports original empirical results.

M1.justification: The methods were unavailable for inspection, preventing comparison of algorithms, models, objectives, and procedures.

E1.justification: Dataset, task, and test-scenario coverage could not be inspected in either PDF.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons were unavailable, so baseline membership could not be matched between versions.

E3.justification: Experimental protocols and settings could not be inspected or compared.

E4.justification: Neither version's ablations, robustness tests, or supplementary analyses could be inspected.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and statistical uncertainty reporting were unavailable for comparison.

E6.justification: Tables, figures, and result passages could not be read, preventing verification of numerical or qualitative changes.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected in either version.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions were unavailable, preventing comparison of core claims and contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations, mechanism explanations, applicability boundaries, and limitations could not be inspected.

D1.justification: Implementation details and reproducibility disclosures could not be compared because neither PDF was readable through the available tools.

R1.justification: Citations and research-positioning passages could not be inspected or matched.

P1.justification: Document text was unavailable, preventing assessment of language editing, terminology, or structural changes.

P2.justification: Page images, figures, and tables were unavailable for visual comparison.

improvement.justification: No document content was successfully inspected. Without before-and-after evidence from the supplied PDFs and appendices, the direction or significance of any overall quality change cannot be assessed.
